data.description: All nightshades have a 30-foot-radius emanation equivalent to a desecrate spell centered on a shrine of evil power.  Undead within this radius (including the nightshade) gain a +2 profane bonus on attack and damage rolls and saving throws, as well as +2 hit points per die, and the save DC of channeled negative energy is increased by +6 (these adjustments are included for the nightshades in their entries).  This aura can be negated by dispel evil, but a nightshade can reactivate it on its turnas a free action.  A desecrating aura suppresses and is suppressed by consecrate or hallow; both effects are negated wtihin any overlapping area of effect.
